# Court Vision

> Court Vision is a free basketball GM and simulation game that runs in the browser (and as an installable app). Run an NBA franchise from any season since 1946-47 with real players, or play quick modes: the 82-0 Challenge, League Hunt, Career Mode, the Rebuild Challenge and the All-Time Draft. Every game is simulated possession by possession. No download or account needed.

- Play free: https://courtvisiongame.com/
- Price: free on the web (ad-supported); a free offline Windows edition has no ads.
- Platforms: any modern browser on desktop, phone or tablet; installable as an app; offline Windows edition.
- Data: real NBA statistics from Basketball-Reference.com; Court Vision computes its own ratings. Independent fan project, not affiliated with the NBA.
- Community: https://discord.gg/5uGK5HDS8e

## Game modes

| Mode | Time | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 82-0 Challenge | 5-10 min | Build a ten-man team from all of NBA history and try to go 82-0, then 16-0 in the playoffs, against real teams and boss teams like the 72-10 Bulls. |
| Career Mode | 5-15 min | Create one player and live his whole career, from draft night to the Hall of Fame and the all-time Top 100. |
| Rebuild Challenge | 10-20 min | Take over a real team at its lowest point in NBA history and win a title before time runs out. |
| All-Time Draft | 10-20 min | Thirty teams draft every player in history at his best, then play a full season. |
| League Hunt | 15-30 min a run | Spin a six-man squad and a coach from all of history and win ten best-of-seven series against great teams from every era. |
| Survival | Varies | Protect a Franchise Player while historical opponents claim players after wins. One loss ends the run. |
| Story Mode | Varies | Street to the League combines simulated games, characters and choices. |
| Your Career | Varies | Begin at age 13 and choose a path through youth basketball, training and professional opportunities. |
| Real League (Franchise) | Unlimited | Run a real NBA franchise from any season since 1946-47: draft, trade, sign, coach. |
| Random Players (Franchise) | Unlimited | A generated 30-team league for pure franchise building. |

## Guides

- [Career Mode](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/career-mode.html): How Career Mode works in Court Vision: building a player on the wheel of NBA history or in MyPlayer, development, free agency, awards, the Hall of Fame and the Top 100.
- [League Hunt](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/league-hunt.html): How League Hunt works in Court Vision: spinning a six-man squad from basketball history, era rules, best-of-seven series, boosts, shops, difficulty and the Daily Legend.
- [82-0 Challenge](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/82-0-challenge.html): How the 82-0 Challenge works in Court Vision: building a ten-man team from NBA history, Quick Spin and Franchise Spin, boss teams, lineup rules, chemistry, scoring, the Daily 82-0 and rewards.
- [All-Time Draft](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/all-time-draft.html): How the All-Time Draft works in Court Vision: thirty teams draft every player in NBA history at his best season, AI GMs who draft for need, and a full season under any era's rules.
- [Rebuild Challenge](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/rebuild-challenge.html): How the Rebuild Challenge works in Court Vision: take over a real NBA team at its lowest point and win a championship before the clock runs out.
- [Real NBA history](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/real-nba-history.html): How Court Vision's Real League works: real rosters from any season since 1946-47, real careers, real draft classes, ratings computed from statistics, and Real Player Development.
- [Ratings explained](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/ratings-explained.html): How Court Vision rates players and teams: player Overall, the 0-100 team rating matched to real win totals, ratings past 99, the Legacy Score and the all-time Top 100.
- [How the simulation works](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/how-the-simulation-works.html): Inside Court Vision's game engine: every game is played possession by possession, and the box score is counted from what happened. Ball handlers, 14 shot types, contests, turnovers, rebounds, fatigue and badges explained.
- [Badges explained](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/badges-explained.html): Every Court Vision badge and what it does to a player's ratings: shooting, ball handling, defense, finishing, passing and rebounding badges, how players earn them, and the Sandbox-only experimental badges.
- [Survival](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/survival.html): How Survival works in Court Vision: draft ten of fourteen all-time greats, tag a Franchise Player, then beat real NBA teams one game at a time while every win costs you a player. Levels, bosses, Shields, emergency signings and scoring.
- [Your Career](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/your-career.html): How Your Career works in Court Vision: build a player at 13, choose a high school, college, pro academy or Europe, declare for the draft, sign contracts and chase awards. Positions, ratings, growth by age and Legacy explained.
- [Story Mode](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/story-mode.html): How Story Mode works in Court Vision: five chapters from a city park to draft night, then fifteen NBA seasons. Four playing styles, real games on the court, and choices about friends, family and rivals that change your ending.
- [Coaching & development](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/coaching-and-development.html): How coaching and player development work in Court Vision franchise leagues: hiring staff, offensive systems and defensive schemes, rotation styles, practice calendars, development plans, mentors, badges and morale.

## About and help

- [About](https://courtvisiongame.com/about.html): Court Vision is a free, browser-based pixel-art basketball management game with real NBA history, a full simulation engine, and seven game modes, from franchise GM to the 82-0 Challenge.
- [How to Play](https://courtvisiongame.com/how-to-play.html): Start your first Court Vision league: choosing a team, setting a rotation, the season calendar, trades, the draft, free agency and the offseason.
- [FAQ](https://courtvisiongame.com/faq.html): Learn how to play CourtVision, choose between seven basketball simulation modes, understand ratings and relics, back up saves, and manage accounts and privacy.
- [Changelog](https://courtvisiongame.com/changelog.html): What's new in Court Vision: the 82-0 Challenge, Mode of the Week, Career Mode big moments, the All-Time Draft, League Hunt and more.
- [Contact](https://courtvisiongame.com/contact.html): Contact CourtVision support by email or through the NineFoldVision Discord community. Learn what to include in a bug report and how to find save recovery and account deletion controls.
- [Terms](https://courtvisiongame.com/terms.html): The terms for playing Court Vision: who can create an account (13 and older), fair play on leaderboards, GM names and clubs, in-game items, advertising, and how the free game is provided.
